It's not redeemable on Digital Goods & Amazon Pay Categories. Please see our Amazon Pay product for the possibility to pay bills and many more options.

Please note: Amazon Shopping Voucher is NOT ELIGIBLE for the following shopping transactions on & off Amazon:
  • Bill Payments
  • Ticket Bookings: Flight, Train, Movies, Bus
  • Recharges: Mobile, DTH, Google Play, FastTag, Metro
  • Utilities: Gas Cylinders, Piped Gas, Subscriptions, Cable TV etc
  • Transaction outside of Amazon.in where Amazon Pay is a payment option
  • Transaction on any Amazon Pay Categories including and not limited to ( including future Pay categories available on Amazon Pay Dashboard )
  • Investments & Insurance
  • Purchase of Kindle eBooks
  • Purchase of Digital Content like e-Books, Video Games
  • Purchase of Amazon Pay Gift Cards or Adding Money to Amazon Pay Balance
  • Purchase of Brand Gift Cards that are designated Semi-Closed Loop (SCLP) Instruments under PPI Master Direction
  • Donations
" instructions: "Desktop:
  1. Visit amazon.in/vouchers
  2. Enter the Alpha numeric voucher code
  3. Click on 'Add Voucher' button

Mobile:

  1. Open your Amazon App
  2. Click \"More\" on the bottom navigation bar
  3. Click Pay Bills, Send Money and more
  4. On the top most section of the Amazon Pay page opened, slide it to the right until the end
  5. Click on 'Vouchers'
  6. Enter the Alpha numeric voucher code
  7. Click on 'Add Voucher' button
" termsConditions: "TERMS & CONDITIONS :A customer can add a maximum of ₹50,000 of Amazon Shopping Voucher in a calendar month.
The Add Gift Card to balance limit Includes purchases from all sources.
A customer might need to go through additional verification during the addition of Amazon Shopping Vouchers.
Amazon reserves the right to modify this (Add Gift Card to balance) limit at any point of time.
Add Gift Card to balance Limit resets at the beginning of each calendar month , a customer can resume adding Gift-card after this reset.
What are vouchers? - Vouchers are a payment instrument designed to be accepted for a specific set of products on Amazon. Currently there is one valid voucher type: Amazon Shopping Voucher.
Amazon Shopping voucher is redeemable across all physical goods purchase on Amazon.in.
Amazon Vouchers (including Amazon Shopping Voucher, Amazon Prime Voucher and Amazon Fresh Voucher) are not eligible for use on Amazon Business marketplace effective 15th November ’23
How is a voucher different from an Amazon Pay Gift Card? - While Amazon Pay Gift Card & Vouchers both are pre-paid instruments, an Amazon Pay Gift Card is accepted across all avenues where Amazon Pay Wallet is accepted whereas a voucher is only accepted as per its design. For example: (1) an Amazon Shopping Voucher will only work on valid shopping transactions on Amazon and not valid for Pay category transactions (2) An Amazon Prime Voucher will work only for purchase of Prime Membership and so on.
Amazon Shopping Voucher is NOT ELIGIBLE for the following shopping transactions on & off Amazon:
Purchase of Kindle eBooks.
Purchase of Digital Content like e-Books, Video Games.
Purchase of Amazon Pay Gift Cards or Adding Money to Amazon Pay Balance.
Purchase of Brand Gift Cards that are designated Semi-Closed Loop(SCLP) Instruments under PPI Master Direction.
Transaction outside of Amazon.in where Amazon Pay is a payment option.
Transaction on any Amazon Pay Categories including and not limited to (including future Pay categories available on Amazon Pay Dashboard):
Recharges: Mobile, DTH, Google Play, FastTag, Metro
Bill Payments
Ticket Bookings: Flight, Train, Movies, Bus
Investments & Insurance
Utilities: Gas Cylinders, Piped Gas, Subscriptions, Cable TV etc.
Donations
How to use an Amazon shopping voucher? - A voucher can be used to buy only those items made eligible for it. When a voucher is eligible on an order (where all items in the cart are eligible for the specific voucher), ‘Your Vouchers’ will be show up as a payment option in payment method selection page. To use ‘Your Vouchers’ for the purchase, select it on the payment method selection page. If the voucher value is not sufficient, you can combine Amazon Pay balance, credit/debit card or net banking with your vouchers to complete the purchase. You can click on the ‘Know More’ option to find the list of vouchers eligible for that specific purchase.
Can I cancel/return a shopping voucher? - Vouchers once purchased cannot be cancelled or returned due to regulations.
What if I return a product purchased via an Amazon shopping voucher? - When you return a product purchased via a voucher, the respective amount barring cashback, if any, will be refunded to the original source. The vouchers will be reissued and credited to ‘Your Vouchers’ directly." payment_methods: address_based[24]: ethereum,eth_base,usdc_base,usdt_erc20,usdt_trc20,usdc_erc20,usdc_polygon,usdt_polygon,usdc_arbitrum,usdt_arbitrum,usdc_solana,usdt_solana,solana,eth_arbitrum,usdc_bsc,usdt_bsc,lightning,ark,bitcoin,dogecoin,dash,litecoin,ton,usdt_ton link_only[6]: fiat_card,google_pay,apple_pay,ideal,eps,p24 balance[2]: balance,cashback
